task: BENCH-02 slice — analyze and close the 10 independent-primal-recheck failures
question: BENCH-02 recorded 10 independent primal re-check failures (2 of 63 cells x 5 repeats) while the same rows returned solver status Optimal with VERIFIED certificates. This record analyzes every failed row, explains why the harness and the solver disagreed, fixes the reporting defect the comparison exposed, and states what did not change: no campaign row, status or verdict is rewritten (benchmark-campaign.md sections 7 and 8).

failed_rows.engine: QP -> qp (classifier; declared MILP in the corpus)

defect.statement: The solver's JSON field maximum_primal_violation was emitted as exactly 0 for both engines' QP path while diagnostic.primal_residual and the row slacks carried the real measured values. The campaign harness (section 8) reads that JSON field, so it compared a defaulted zero against its own independent re-check instead of the solver's own measurement.
defect.cause: src/api/engine_qp.cpp never filled out.primal_report; apps/json_output.hpp maps maximum_primal_violation from primal_report.maximum_row_violation, so the defaulted struct serialized as 0. The verification decision (qp::verify_qp_solution at 1e-4) and the KKT certificate were computed independently and were never wrong.
defect.classification: Reporting data-quality defect in the production CLI JSON, not a solver-verification defect: both engines' acceptance gates were satisfied and the independent harness re-check was right to fail the rows against its own 1e-6 bar.

three_tolerance_scales.campaign_harness: 1e-6 absolute on the row violation the harness recomputes from the solver's primal (benchmark-campaign.md section 7, T5/T6/T7 are harness bars, not solver gates)
three_tolerance_scales.solve_gate: 1e-6 absolute + 1e-6 relative x (sum_i |a_ij x_j| + |b_i|) row scale (src/qp/convergence.hpp). For QPLIB_0010 row C00000001: row scale 1.0000012800963956 + side 1 gives an allowance of 3.0000012800963954e-06 > measured 1.2800963955506006e-06, so the row passes the solve gate and fails the flat harness bar
three_tolerance_scales.engine_certificate: qp::verify_qp_solution(..., 1e-4) — the documented convex-qp.md section 2.4 engine gate, accepted for both instances
three_tolerance_scales.why_no_gate_was_loosened: numerical-policy.md rule 5 / benchmark-campaign.md section 7: a failing row stays failed and the harness bar is unchanged; the fix makes the solver report its own measurement instead of a default zero

fix.commit: e75201d bench-02: report the measured QP primal violation instead of a default zero
fix.change: src/api/engine_qp.cpp fills out.primal_report via verify::verify_primal with the 1e-4/1e-6 engine-gate scale so the report's pass flag can never contradict original_verified; apps/json_output.hpp mapping unchanged (it already read primal_report.maximum_row_violation)
fix.test: tests/qp_primal_report_test.cpp asserts a non-default measured value is serialized for both QP instances

post_fix_observations.note: the solver's serialized field now equals the harness's independent measurement to every printed digit
bench01_mps.check() returns the FIRST violating row, not the maximum; the true maximum sits on balance_5. Both are above the 1e-6 harness bar, so the verdict is identical whichever row is reported

verdicts_unchanged.statement: The 10 rows remain independent_primal_failure in the BENCH-02 record. The campaign was not re-run, no row was dropped or reclassified, and the harness's 1e-6 bar is untouched (benchmark-campaign.md sections 7 and 8). This record closes the defect the comparison exposed in the solver's reporting, not the campaign's failures.
verdicts_unchanged.reason_both_sides_are_correct: The rows really do violate the harness's absolute 1e-6 bar (1.28e-06 and 5.12e-05 measured independently), while the solver's own documented gates (scale-aware 1e-6/1e-6 solve gate, 1e-4 certificate) legitimately accept them — convex-qp.md section 2.4 exists precisely because these scales differ.

open_gaps.gap: The nonlinear engines carry the same class of gap: src/api/engine_nonlinear.cpp never fills primal_report, and src/nlp/nlp_verifier.cpp folds bound violations into inequality_violation, so JSON maximum_primal_violation stays a defaulted 0 for NLP/MINLP results while diagnostics carry residuals under different names.
open_gaps.status: fixed 2026-10-02 in the same reporting shape as the QP path: the NLP/MINLP engines now publish the measured constraint/bound/integrality split through publish_primal_report, with the semantics decision recorded in evidence/nlp-primal-report-2026-10-02.json and numerical-policy.md section 4; before/after CLI JSON in that record (pre-fix maximum_primal_violation 0 beside original_verified true and diagnostic.primal_residual 1.0268474959218565e-08, post-fix the measured value)
